status: Independent original small-batch decode reference qualified; native integration remains open; whole goal active

arithmetic.routed: Original EXL3 small-batch gate/up and down kernels, no substitution with prefill or dense reconstruction
arithmetic.activation: F32 clipping/SiLU and rotated down-input conversion retain source rounding boundaries
arithmetic.reduction: Original per-warp weighted partials followed by fixed warp-order F32 summation
arithmetic.shared: Independent source FP16 shared FFN, F32 down output, then F32 addition
arithmetic.launch: Ordinary A/B launches; extra rotation and run-table kernel for rows > 1
arithmetic.geometry: On selected 188-SM Blackwell GPU: wide gate/up for every row count; down narrow for 1..5 and wide for 6..8; both split counts 1; scratch slots_max stays 8*topk
arithmetic.counter_lifetime: A clears B counters at entry; B clears A counters at entry. B counters need not be zero after completion. Two consecutive calls reuse the same buffers without host clearing.

limitations: Independent source oracle only; no native small-batch decode implementation qualified
Learned router layer39 only; full forward remains unqualified. V4.1 defaults to zero hash-routing layers.
Actual K=6 geometry only; alternate top-k and synthetic narrow gate geometry not covered
No throughput or vLLM parity claim
qualification.build_warnings: Six original-source nvcc diagnostic 20012 warnings for explicitly defaulted device constructors; upstream normally suppresses 20012. No production build performed or modified.

next: Port source-shaped small-batch arithmetic to the native CUDA backend with request-owned scratch and bounded expert leases, then compare every intermediate against these preserved references. Keep full-model admission gated.
